default.notes: Visitor's visa required — apply in advance at a Guyanese embassy, high commission or consulate before travelling.

groups.notes: CARICOM nationals enjoy freedom of movement under the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas — an automatic stay of six months is granted on arrival, and holders of a CARICOM Skills Certificate may live and work in Guyana.
Visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days; the officer at the border writes the actual permitted stay into your passport, and the Central Immigration and Passport Office in Georgetown can extend it.

Plan on needing a visitor's visa arranged in advance — this nationality is sometimes listed among Guyana's visa-exempt countries, but the lists are inconsistent, so confirm with the nearest Guyanese embassy or high commission before booking.

GY.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Guyanese citizens.

CN.notes: Visa required in advance. Guyana's mutual visa-waiver arrangement with China has been announced and suspended more than once — check the current position with the Guyanese embassy in Beijing before travelling.
